title: [BUG} APPS 3.3.3.0-dev-de Client. Pump change not synced on Client (3.3.3.0-dev-d), visible in Nightscout
symptom: On AAPS 3.3.3.0-dev-d, pump changes (e.g. reservoir/cannula) made on the Master are not shown on the Client, although they appear correctly in Nightscout. The cannula gauge in the Client app shows 3d 12h while it should be 10h after a pump change.
